<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 23, 2026, the Compensation Committee of the board of directors
(the &#8220;Board&#8221;) of Ionetix Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), acting pursuant to authority delegated to it by the Board,
granted the following stock option awards under the Company&#8217;s 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;2026 Equity Plan&#8221;):</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-indent: -0.25in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">1.</td><td style="text-align: justify">a stock option to purchase 1,025,600 shares of the Company&#8217;s
common stock granted to Kevin Cameron, the Company&#8217;s President and Chief Executive Officer; and</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-indent: -0.25in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">2.</td><td style="text-align: justify">a stock option to purchase 854,700 shares of the Company&#8217;s
common stock granted to Phieu Phun, the Company&#8217;s Chief Financial Officer.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Each option has an exercise price of $3.00 per
share, which the Board determined to be the fair market value of a share of the Company&#8217;s common stock on the grant date. Each option
is subject to the 2026 Equity Plan and the applicable award agreement. Each option will vest as to 25% of the shares subject to the option
on the first anniversary of the grant date and as to 1/36<sup>th</sup> of the remaining shares monthly over the 36-month period thereafter,
subject to the applicable named executive officer&#8217;s continued service to the Company through each applicable vesting date, and expires
10 years from the grant date, subject to earlier termination in accordance with the 2026 Equity Plan and the applicable award agreement.
Each option is also subject to the applicable employment agreement between Ionetix Radioisotopes, Inc. (formerly known as Ionetix Corporation)
(&#8220;Radioisotopes&#8221;), the Company&#8217;s wholly owned subsidiary, and such named executive officer dated April 1, 2026, which
provides for full vesting acceleration upon an Involuntary Separation (as defined in the employment agreements), subject to the named
executive officer&#8217;s execution and non-revocation of a release of claims and return of company property. The employment agreements
also provide for full acceleration upon a qualifying termination in connection with or following a Change of Control (as defined in the
employment agreements) and, subject to the continued-service conditions set forth in the employment agreements, immediately prior to a
Change of Control in which awards are neither assumed nor substituted.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The foregoing description of the option awards does not purport to
be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the 2026 Equity Plan, which was previously filed as Exhibit 10.7 to the Company&#8217;s
Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on April 16, 2026, the form of stock option award agreement
under the 2026 Equity Plan, filed as Exhibit 10.6 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, and the employment agreements incorporated by reference
as Exhibits 10.4 and 10.5 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, each of which is incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Item 8.01 Other Events.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Non-Employee Director Compensation Plan and Equity Awards</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 23, 2026, the Board, upon the recommendation of the Compensation
Committee of the Board, approved and adopted the Ionetix Corporation Non-Employee Director Compensation Plan (the &#8220;Director Compensation
Plan&#8221;), effective upon adoption. The Director Compensation Plan governs compensation payable to non-employee directors for their
service on the boards of directors of the Company and its subsidiaries and the committees of those boards.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Director Compensation Plan does not presently provide for the payment
of cash retainers to non-employee directors. It provides for equity awards under the 2026 Equity Plan, including initial awards to persons
who first become non-employee directors and annual awards to continuing non-employee directors.</p>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b></b></p>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2; Options: NewSection -->
    <div style="border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><p style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->1<!-- Field: /Sequence --></p></div>
    <div style="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><p style="margin: 0pt">&#160;</p></div>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b></b>&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Under the Director Compensation Plan: (i) an initial award consists
of a nonstatutory stock option covering the number of shares approved by the Board; (ii) an annual award, granted within 15 business days
following each annual meeting of stockholders (or such other date on which the composition of the Board for that year is determined),
consists of nonstatutory stock options and restricted stock units covering the number of shares approved by the Board; (iii) initial option
awards generally vest over four years, with 25% vesting on the first anniversary of the grant date and the remainder vesting monthly over
the following three years; (iv) annual option awards generally vest on the first anniversary of the grant date; (v) restricted stock units
generally vest on January 1 of the year following the year of grant; and (vi) all outstanding awards fully vest upon a change in control
(as defined in the 2026 Equity Plan). Vesting is generally subject to the director&#8217;s continued service, and each award remains subject
to the 2026 Equity Plan and the applicable award agreement. Options granted under the Director Compensation Plan have an exercise price
of not less than the fair market value of a share of the Company&#8217;s common stock on the grant date and expire 10 years after the
grant date, unless the 2026 Equity Plan provides for earlier expiration. The Board may waive vesting and forfeiture conditions in circumstances
it determines to be appropriate.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In connection with the adoption of the Director Compensation Plan,
the Board approved the following awards under the 2026 Equity Plan:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-indent: -0.25in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">1.</td><td style="text-align: justify">an initial award to Michael Stewart consisting of a nonstatutory
stock option to purchase 175,000 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock; and</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-indent: -0.25in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">2.</td><td style="text-align: justify">an annual award to each of Gregory Martin, Douglas Boothe,
and Michael Tarnok, consisting of a nonstatutory stock option to purchase 100,000 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock and 15,000
restricted stock units.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The exercise price of each option is $3.00 per share, which the Board
determined to be the fair market value of a share of the Company&#8217;s common stock on the grant date. Each award is subject to the
vesting terms of the Director Compensation Plan described above.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The foregoing description of the Director Compensation Plan does not
purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Director Compensation Plan, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit
10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. The awards are subject to the 2026 Equity Plan and the
forms of stock option award agreement and restricted stock unit award agreement thereunder, copies of which are filed as Exhibits 10.6
and 10.7 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and are incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Annual Performance Bonus Plan</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 23, 2026, the board of directors of Radioisotopes, upon
the recommendation of the Compensation Committee of the Board, approved and adopted the Ionetix Radioisotopes, Inc. Annual Performance
Bonus Plan (the &#8220;Bonus Plan&#8221;), effective for the 2026 calendar year and each subsequent year until amended or terminated.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Bonus Plan provides eligible full-time employees of Radioisotopes
with an opportunity to earn discretionary annual cash bonuses based on target bonus percentages of base salary, the achievement of annual
corporate goals and objectives, and individual performance. Radioisotopes&#8217; Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer are
not eligible to participate in the Bonus Plan. The Compensation Committee of the Board oversees the administration of the Bonus Plan and
approves target bonus percentages by employee category, and Radioisotopes&#8217; Chief Executive Officer determines individual bonuses.
In general, no bonuses are earned for a year unless the Compensation Committee determines that Radioisotopes has achieved at least 80%
of its overall corporate goals and objectives for that year, and an individual bonus may not exceed 120% of the participant&#8217;s target
bonus, in each case unless the Compensation Committee approves otherwise. Participants generally must remain employed through the payment
date to receive a bonus.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The foregoing description of the Bonus Plan does not purport to be
complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Bonus Plan, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.2 to this Current Report
on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b></b></p>
